info.name: Policy Management API
info.description: Technical assessment APIs — upload, policy search/aggregate, schedule, health.

request.description: Liveness check. Not rate-limited. Look for x-request-id in response headers.

formdata.description: Select data/sample-policy-data.csv from the project root

request.description: Multipart upload. Field name must be `file`. Parses CSV/XLSX in a worker thread and upserts into MongoDB collections.

response.name: Upload Policy file

formdata.description: Select data/sample-policy-data.csv from the project root

response.name: Search by username

request.description: Returns per-user policy counts and policy lists.

response.name: Aggregate policies by user

request.description: day = YYYY-MM-DD, time = HH:mm (24h). Must be in the future (local server time). Cron delivers every minute.
